name: @convolens/chrome-extension
description: ConvoLens Chrome Extension for WhatsApp Web

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:prod && npm run prepare:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir .firefox-package --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package: npm run build:prod && npm run prepare:firefox && node scripts/package-extension.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:tsx && npm run test:jest
scripts.test:tsx: tsx --test tests/automatic-capture.test.ts tests/dom-selectors.test.ts tests/guided-capture.test.ts tests/media-evidence.test.ts tests/phase1-capture-safety.test.ts tests/phase2-fidelity.test.ts tests/phase3-operation-state.test.ts tests/phase4-launcher-auth.test.ts tests/phase5-preview.test.ts tests/phase6-guided-lifecycle.test.ts tests/phase7-automatic-lifecycle.test.ts tests/phase8-operational-actions.test.ts tests/phase9-release-evidence.test.ts tests/popup-runtime.test.ts tests/virtualized-capture-fixture.test.ts tests/whatsapp-identity.test.ts tests/whatsapp-metadata.test.ts tests/whatsapp-page-identity.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:persistence: pnpm --filter @convolens/api build && npm run build && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.persistence.config.ts
